surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process involves alternating exposures to lithium tert-butoxide (LTB) and hydrogen sulfide (H2S) for Li2S ALD, and tris(dimethylamido)aluminum(III) (TDMA-Al) and H2S for Al2S3 ALD. The growth of LixAlyS films is achieved by controlling the ratio of Li2S to Al2S3 ALD cycles, resulting in a stable interface between lithium metal and liquid carbonate electrolytes.
